_comment: Recorded native-versus-WASM browser divergences for the WASM parity gate. Each entry must state the fixture, the mechanism, the measured magnitude, and a tight bound so differences cannot silently grow.

components_i_cabinzone_dynamic.reason: ode23s transient with MoistAirSource/CabinZone evaluating HAPropsSI in the loop. rustprop uses std::f64::exp/ln/powf which resolves to glibc natively and compiler-rt/libm on wasm32; 1-ulp property variations integrate to a trajectory difference against the native golden. Since 2026-11-28 ode23s reuses its Jacobian (FX6), and an ulp can tip a refresh decision, so the difference is 1.23e-8 (shell$q, row 4); it was 6.66e-9 when every step formed its own.

ev-battery-cooling-pid.reason: ode23s transient (4000 s, 400 rows) of a five-domain closed loop: BatteryPack -> LiquidWallHX cold plate -> Chiller (MovingBoundaryEvaporator, R134a) -> EXVCmd under a clamped PID. Its golden was regenerated natively on 2026-10-21 (LiquidWallHX exact isothermal-wall law), so native replay is exact; wasm32 resolves rustprop's exp/ln/powf through compiler-rt/libm instead of glibc, and the 1-ulp property differences integrate through the PID loop. The worst cell is ch.ev$l_tp at row 49 (1.38e-5 of its column scale), where the evaporator's smooth-min zone-length corner amplifies them. Since 2026-11-28 ode23s reuses its Jacobian (FX6) and the golden is regenerated for it; an ulp can tip a refresh decision, which took the worst cell from 4.43e-6 (row 45) to 1.38e-5. Before the regeneration this fixture carried a 3.6e-6 rustprop-vs-Java relaxation that absorbed the same effect.

moving-boundary-hx-transient-warmup-birt.reason: IDA transient (60 s, 40 rows): a ThermalMass wall warms a MovingBoundaryEvaporator until its superheat zone is born through zone_ramp. Its golden was regenerated natively on 2026-11-19 (epsilon-NTU single-phase zone law), so native replay is exact; wasm32 resolves rustprop's exp/ln/powf through compiler-rt/libm instead of glibc, the ulp differences move IDA's adaptive steps near the zone birth, and the interpolated ev$sh rows differ by up to 3.5e-4 K (2.96e-5 of the 11.85 K column scale) with alternating sign, while the final values agree to 3.1e-6. Before the regeneration this fixture's 2.4e-5 Java tolerance covered the same spread.
